4b2bf545c76f36a6.description: About the Role Elsewedy Electric Power Systems Projects is seeking a Construction Team Leader Mechanical to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves leading and mentoring the mechanical site engineering team and workforce, ensuring efficient project execution in line with established schedules. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to lead, direct, and mentor the mechanical site engineering team and workforce by example. This includes ensuring seamless inter-team coordination, transparent communication of work plans, and constraint-free execution in adherence to baseline project schedules. Key Responsibilities Understand mechanical construction scope and objectives, involving the team, and ensuring technical feasibility. Determine project phases and their scheduling based on baselines provided by the construction manager. Prepare method statements required for construction activities. Review risk assessments to ensure compliance with method statement requirements. Manage relationships between the team, the client, and all stakeholders. Oversee dealings with mechanical sub-contractors and other necessary personnel. Ensure the availability of equipment and materials required for construction activities. Resolve issues that may arise during plan execution, including weather conditions or emergencies, which could delay project completion. Report and escalate issues to Construction Management as required. Measure construction team performance using available tools and techniques. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in construction. Demonstrated ability to lead, direct, and mentor engineering teams and workforces. Strong understanding of mechanical construction scope and objectives. Proficiency in preparing method statements and reviewing risk assessments. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with project responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role requires active on-site leadership and coordination within a dynamic construction environment.

4b467e41493a90b2.description: About the Role moomoo is seeking a Growth & Market Specialist to drive market presence and growth in KSA. This full-time role focuses on managing various advertising and marketing channels to ensure effective campaign performance and return on investment (ROI). Key Responsibilities Establish and manage AppsFlyer tracking to monitor campaign performance, attribution, conversions, and ROI. Plan and manage influencer advertising campaigns, including selection, coordination, execution, and performance evaluation. Oversee Out-Of-Home (OOH) advertising across KSA, covering key business districts, malls, digital screens, and other strategic locations. Identify and manage advertising opportunities across relevant local apps in KSA to maximize reach, engagement, and campaign performance. Manage programmatic advertising activities, ensuring effective audience targeting, campaign optimization, and performance. Coordinate TV commercials, news coverage, and media placements to support brand awareness and campaign objectives. Work closely with the Global Marketing Team to develop, align, localize, and execute the KSA paid media plan. Manage media budgets, monitor campaign performance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and maximize ROI. Performance Metrics The role's success will be measured against the following key performance indicators: Return on Investment (ROI/ROAS): Measuring and optimizing returns on paid media investment. Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC): Monitoring and improving acquisition efficiency. App Installs & Conversions: Tracking app installations, registrations, and customer acquisition. 4b4e19a9539b4448.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is an AEP/PMCM firm recognized among the Top 225 International Design Firms and Top 20 International PM/CM Firms by ENR. The company is also ranked as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in the 2024 WA100 Survey by World Architecture. KEO has over 60 years of experience in planning, design, and project delivery across built and natural environments. The Role: Document Controller Manager KEO International Consultants is seeking a Document Controller Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 10 years of experience and involves establishing and maintaining comprehensive document control systems for projects, including the construction phase and the 12-month Defects Liability Period. Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain a comprehensive Document Control System for the project duration. Implement and manage the approved Electronic Document Management System (EDMS), such as Aconex or equivalent, for all project documentation. Develop and enforce standard document numbering, filing, and transmittal procedures in line with client and consultant requirements. Receive, log, and distribute all Contractor submissions, including Shop Drawings, Material Approval Requests (MARs), Method Statements, Technical Specifications, Calculations, RFIs, As-Built Drawings, and O&M Manuals. Maintain a live, up-to-date tracker of all submissions with clear status indicators. Ensure timely return of reviewed documents with Comment Review Sheets (CRS) and track the open/close status of comments. Control all incoming and outgoing project correspondence, instructions, notices, and reports between stakeholders. Prepare and issue formal transmittals and maintain accurate records of all communications. Support the team in the preparation and compilation of Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Reports. Ensure all quality-related documentation (ITPs, MIRs, WIRs, inspection records, test results, NCRs) is properly filed and easily retrievable. Support the compilation of the Project Completion Dossier and Handover Package. Maintain records for audit, claims, variations, and regulatory compliance purposes. Provide accurate document status updates for Weekly and Monthly Progress Meetings. Prepare document control metrics and reports as required by the Senior Project Manager/Project Director. Archive all project records in a structured, secure, and indexed manner at project close-out. Provide training and guidance to the supervision team on document control procedures and EDMS usage. Coordinate with discipline leads to ensure timely review and response to submissions. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in document control and management. Proficiency in establishing and maintaining comprehensive document control systems. Experience with Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) such as Aconex or similar platforms. Strong understanding of document numbering, filing, and transmittal procedures. Ability to manage and track various project submissions and correspondence effectively. Work Environment and Culture KEO fosters a supportive environment that prioritizes professional development through global mobility and career advancement opportunities. The company culture supports health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. KEO also offers a competitive package with benefits, including hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards.

Support testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), cutover, go-live, and post-go-live activities. Troubleshoot functional issues and optimize SAP PP/QM processes. Work closely with business users and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in SAP PP/QM consulting. Effective communication skills. Project Duration This is an 8-month project-based role focused on cloud transformation. The consultant will collaborate closely with business users and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective functional solutions. 4b6e8d452e3195df.company_name: The Saudi Ice Cream Factory Company
4b6e8d452e3195df.description: About the Role The Saudi Ice Cream Factory Company is seeking an Export Executive to drive international growth. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on expanding the company's global presence for its soft serve ice cream and dairy cream portfolio, which includes whipping and cooking cream products. Key Responsibilities Identify, pursue, and convert new international customers and distribution partners. Manage the complete export sales cycle and cultivate long-term relationships with existing accounts. Negotiate commercial terms and achieve agreed-upon export sales targets. 4bf61a91541cb44a.job_title: Associate Technician After Sales Mobile Service

The position contributes to customer satisfaction by ensuring vehicles are serviced efficiently, safely, and in alignment with company standards. Key Responsibilities Perform vehicle diagnostics to identify, analyze, and resolve complex mechanical and electrical issues on various vehicle systems, including high-voltage and low-voltage components, using industry-standard diagnostic tools and software. Provide on-site diagnostic and repair services at customer locations using mobile workshop equipment, ensuring timely and efficient resolution in line with service standards. Maintain mobile van inventory, tools, and equipment readiness, ensuring proper stock control, documentation, and compliance with safety and operational procedures. Execute mechanical repairs, including brake system maintenance, suspension adjustments, tire services, and drivetrain repairs, to support optimal vehicle performance. Operate specialized diagnostic equipment and computer-based systems to identify and resolve technical issues efficiently. Collaborate with service advisors to explain diagnostic results, recommend repairs, and provide accurate time estimates. Efficiently and accurately complete servicing and repair tasks, including documenting work performed, parts used, and labor time. Perform quality control inspections on completed repairs to verify the accuracy and functionality of work performed. Maintain a professional and customer-focused attitude, addressing customer concerns and providing excellent service. Collaborate closely with the Parts Department to ensure timely ordering, tracking, and availability of all required components. Stay updated with the latest technical information, service bulletins, and equipment manufacturer guidelines to ensure accurate and efficient servicing and repairs. Continuously identify opportunities for process improvements and participate in problem-solving initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Maintain a clean and organized work area, ensuring proper handling and storage of tools and equipment.

4b121ab6a52d2da2.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Operator; JIB Crane to join their team in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of various types and sizes of Jib Cranes, adhering to established instructions and safety protocols. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily visual inspections of the crane for defects and report any issues promptly. Perform precise lifting, lowering, and maneuvering of materials within the workshop(s). Adhere to instructions from L&R signalmen, foremen, and supervisors, in accordance with L&R operation and safety procedures. Operate the crane within its designed Safe Working Load (SWL), following the operation manual, load charts, and supervisor instructions, while being aware of crane limits in terms of reach and capacity. Complete the daily operations crane checklist before any operation. Assume full responsibility for all safety and quality aspects related to crane setup, load rigging, lifts, movements, dismantling, and relocation. Oversee crane maintenance, load, and functional tests. Perform operator-driven front-end maintenance as required. Ensure proper licensing and inspections are current and coordinate necessary equipment maintenance and repairs with the L&R supervisor, TS inspection division, and Maintenance team. Stop unsafe activities and report potential hazards to the L&R foreman, supervisor, and safety team. Perform physical activities and assist in workshop rigging and fabrication tasks. Provide input for daily work sheets and crane time sheets for each project. Ensure all required documents and permits are available before executing operations. Work effectively in a standard field environment, maintaining awareness of surroundings and ongoing operations, including forklift and manlift sizes and required movement areas. Assist in training local workforce as needed and share knowledge with the team. Complete daily pre-use check sheets and record all identified faults. Assist riggers and other functions as required or directed by the supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in crane operation. Demonstrated ability to operate various types and sizes of Jib Cranes. Strong understanding of safety requirements and operational procedures for crane use. Required Skills Proficiency in inspecting cranes for visual defects and reporting issues. Ability to interpret and follow instructions from signalmen, foremen, and supervisors. Competence in filling out daily operation checklists and maintaining records. Awareness of crane limits, load charts, and operational manuals. Commitment to safety protocols and hazard reporting. Ability to perform physical activities and assist in rigging and fabrication. Effective communication and teamwork skills. Work Environment This role operates within a standard field environment, requiring constant awareness of surroundings and ongoing operations, including the movement and operation of heavy equipment such as forklifts and manlifts. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

4b0b2eb819d2f277.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة قناص العربية عن طاهي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. تتضمن هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية إعداد وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة، بالإضافة إلى ضمان نظافة المطبخ والأدوات. الراتب الشهري لهذه الوظيفة يتراوح بين 4400 و 4500 ريال سعودي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيز وتحضير وطهي اللحوم والدجاج والخضراوات والأطعمة الأخرى لإعداد الأطباق المدرجة في قائمة الطعام. تحضير الشوربات وإعداد السلطات والمقبلات الباردة والساخنة. سلق وطهي الأطعمة الشرقية. تجهيز الأكلات بعد نضوجها ووضعها في الأواني المناسبة وتحضيرها للتقديم. الإشراف على تنظيف أدوات الطبخ والطعام والمحافظة على إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الطهي. القدرة على إعداد مجموعة متنوعة من الأطباق. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة مطبخ احترافية. يجب على شاغل الوظيفة الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية لضمان جودة الأطعمة وسلامة العاملين. معلومات إضافية المسمى الوظيفي: طاهي الشركة: شركة قناص العربية المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الراتب: 4400-4500 ريال سعودي شهرياً

4b146362bcdcd058.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصرف الراجحي عن استشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الأحساء، الجبيل، راس تنورة، القطيف، بقيق، الخفجي، وحفر الباطن. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم وعرض المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمهنية عالية وجودة خدمة ممتازة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال طلبات بيع منتجات المصرف ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها في النظام. استقبال العملاء لفتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيع في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام (DMS). الترحيب بالعملاء عند دخول الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج عند الحاجة. توجيه العملاء لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح وكيفية تنفيذ العمليات المتاحة في أجهزة الصراف الآلي أو القنوات الإلكترونية الأخرى. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص. الاستجابة السريعة لمعالجة مشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفق الإجراءات والتعليمات، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشاكل. استلام طلبات بطاقة الصراف الآلي، إدخالها بالنظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة للعملاء. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات. استلام طلبات قفل الحساب وتعديل بيانات الحساب وتسليمها لمدير العمليات لإدخالها بالنظام. استقبال العميل الموكل، استكمال بيانات نموذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع وإدخاله بالنظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال إجراءات تنفيذها. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وطلبات تحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. استقبال مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة من الصراف الآلي بالفرع، وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها من كبير الصرافين. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن الحالات المخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 1-5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، وتشمل العمل في عدة مدن لخدمة قاعدة عملاء واسعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the safety of swimmers and maintaining a welcoming environment for guests. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Actively observe the swimming area for dangerous conditions, unusual activities, and struggling swimmers. Utilize appropriate rescue techniques when assisting swimmers in need. Promote and enforce the rules and regulations of the recreation facility. Identify situations where guests may not be able to safely participate in an activity and report to a supervisor. Provide initial assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Contribute to a fun and relaxing atmosphere for all guests. Manage towels, including obtaining, folding, and stacking according to company procedures. Perform cleaning duties such as washing, mopping, and cleaning the pool deck. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management and complete required safety training and certifications. Adhere to company policies and procedures, maintain confidentiality, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, maintain a professional appearance, anticipate guest needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. 4b6d5d204a5336a6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة رفيق الاسطول لتقنية المعلومات عن أخصائي مبيعات نظم تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تعريف الشركات المستهدفة بنظام TruckMate المتكامل لتخطيط موارد المؤسسات (ERP) والمخصص لشركات النقل والخدمات اللوجستية، ومتابعة العملاء المحتملين حتى توقيع العقود. هذه الفرصة متاحة في المنطقة الشرقية والرياض، وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. عن مؤسسة رفيق الاسطول لتقنية المعلومات مؤسسة رفيق الاسطول لتقنية المعلومات هي منشأة سعودية تقنية مقرها الدمام. تعمل المؤسسة على تطوير نظام TruckMate، وهو نظام ERP متكامل مصمم خصيصًا لشركات النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. يجمع النظام وظائف متعددة مثل إسناد الرحلات، التتبع المباشر للأسطول، سندات التسليم الإلكترونية، إدارة الورشة وقطع الغيار، والموارد البشرية والرواتب في منصة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات بناء قائمة بالشركات المستهدفة في المنطقة المحددة، والتواصل مع صناع القرار فيها. زيارة الشركات ميدانياً لفهم طريقة إدارتها لأسطولها وعملياتها. ترتيب وتقديم عروض تجريبية للنظام بدعم من فريق TruckMate. متابعة العملاء المحتملين حتى مرحلة التفاوض وتوقيع العقد. تسجيل الزيارات والعملاء في سجل المتابعة، وإرسال تقرير يومي مختصر. تحقيق المستهدفات الأسبوعية من الزيارات والعروض التجريبية. نقل ملاحظات العملاء من الميدان للمساهمة في تطوير النظام. المؤهلات والمتطلبات خبرة في المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع النقل أو الخدمات اللوجستية أو مبيعات الأنظمة. امتلاك علاقات مع شركات نقل أو مقاولات أو توزيع يعتبر ميزة إضافية. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول وسيارة خاصة. مهارات تواصل وإقناع ممتازة باللغة العربية، وإجادة جيدة للغة الإنجليزية. القدرة على العمل باستقلالية في الميدان. طبيعة العمل والمزايا هذا الدور هو عقد عمل مرن وموثق عبر منصة قوى. يتميز بنظام عمولة مجزية على كل عقد يتم توقيعه، مع دخل مفتوح بدون سقف، بالإضافة إلى عمولة إضافية على تجديد العقود. يتيح الدور حرية في تنظيم الوقت وجدول الزيارات، ويوفر تدريباً كاملاً على النظام، وحساباً تجريبياً للعروض، وملفات تعريفية جاهزة لدعم أخصائي المبيعات. مواقع العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في الدمام، وكذلك في مدينة الرياض.

4b912e37aeaeb3b4.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco is seeking a Laser Welding/Cladding Engineer to join the Mechanical Services Shops. This full-time role focuses on developing and qualifying robotic laser-welding and laser-cladding solutions for the repair and restoration of high-value Oil & Gas components. The successful candidate will control various aspects of the process to ensure repeatable deposits and joints suitable for oil and gas service. Role Context The Mechanical Services Shops are responsible for providing repair services for rotating and static equipment, as well as fabricating components. This position is integral to advancing the capabilities in laser-based repair technologies, ensuring metallurgical integrity, precise geometry, and automated processing for critical components. Responsibilities Process Development: Select laser sources, optics, travel speed, power, and preheat/inter-pass controls for laser welding and cladding applications. Robotic Programming & Integration: Develop and validate robot paths, workpiece positioning, seam tracking, motion synchronization, and safety interlocks for repeatable automated processing. Metallurgy & Dilution Control: Define substrate and filler compatibility, control dilution and heat-affected zones, and evaluate cracking, porosity, hardness, and microstructure. Qualification & Inspection: Prepare WPS/PQR or equivalent procedure qualifications, define coupons and acceptance criteria, and coordinate dimensional inspection, assess needed NDTs, metallography, and mechanical testing. Technical Support: Troubleshoot process instability, qualify consumables and suppliers, train operators, maintain traceable records, and improve deposition rate, material utilization, and first-pass yield. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 15 years of experience in a relevant field is required. Work Environment Saudi Aramco offers a professional environment with opportunities for challenging technical and industrial work. The company invests in capital and technology to support world-scale projects and addresses significant technical, logistical, and environmental challenges. 4bdb0b1a95ba4053.description: Job description About Us Soum is on a mission to revolutionize e-commerce in the MENA region and beyond by building the most convenient and trustworthy re-commerce marketplace in the region.
